rows.grounds: compound pāda-ākūṭa-yuta; describes the chariot as fitted with a foot-frame
fused sandhi form: tat + cet + rathaḥ + tat-māna; conditional clause with measure specification
passive result when the stated condition holds

items.question: What condition causes a chariot of specified measure to become released?
premises: The chariot is joined with a foot-frame.
The chariot may be of that specified measure.
A conditional state is being evaluated for that chariot.
items.inference: If such a chariot of that measure meets the stated condition, it is released.
uncertainties: The precise technical sense of ākūṭa in this constructional context is uncertain.
items.plain_english: If that chariot, fitted with a foot-frame and of that measure, is in that condition, it is released.
